remarks: Welcome to 46 Richland Rd, Greenwich. Fully Renovated 2-Bedroom Apartment in Byram. Everything is brand new Be the first to live in this completely remodeled 2-bedroom apartment, located on a quiet residential street in the desirable Byram neighborhood of Greenwich. Every inch of this unit has been thoughtfully renovated from the studs up. Enjoy a brand-new kitchen featuring modern cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and sleek countertops. The bathroom has been fully redone with contemporary fixtures and finishes. Fresh flooring, updated lighting, laundry in-unit and high-efficiency systems complete the transformation. Truly everything is brand new. Just minutes from I-95, local shops, parks, and all that Greenwich has to offer, this apartment offers both tranquility and convenience in one of the area's most accessible locations. Make your appointment today!
